anomalies.observed: Both ground pins on each isolated CAN transceiver are connected to the same GND net: U37.4 (GND1) and U37.5 (GND2), and U57.4 (GND1) and U57.5 (GND2), are all listed on GND.
anomalies.expected: For the specified isolated CAN interfaces, the logic-side GND1 and bus-side GND2 grounds should remain separate; joining them defeats galvanic isolation.
anomalies.impact: The CAN interfaces are not galvanically isolated as intended. Ground disturbances on the CAN side can couple directly into the board's logic ground, reducing the intended noise and transient isolation.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: both CAN transceivers have their logic-side and bus-side ground pins tied to the same GND net, defeating the specified galvanic isolation.
